title: Der: masculine patterns
tip: Many male people, days, months, seasons, weather words, and nouns ending in -er are masculine.

title: Die: feminine patterns
tip: Nouns ending in -ung, -heit, -keit, -schaft, -ion, and -tät are usually feminine.

title: Die: many -e nouns
tip: Many nouns ending in -e are feminine, especially common everyday nouns.

title: Das: diminutives
tip: Words ending in -chen and -lein are always neuter, even when the original word is not.

title: Das: infinitives and young beings
tip: Infinitives used as nouns and many words for young people or animals are neuter.

title: Learn the word together
tip: When a pattern is uncertain, memorize the article as part of the vocabulary word and practise the complete phrase.
